notes: IMPORTANT: add your opening balance once. Open My Details, then Cash & Bank, and put in what your cash drawer and your bank hold today. From this version a payment cannot be more than the drawer or the bank holds, so a purchase paid in cash is refused until the balance is added. Buying on credit is not affected. New: Cash & Bank screen for opening balance and withdrawals. An entry can be changed between Cash, UPI and Bank. Money from a customer is now shown as Received. Expiry is shown on the stock list, on each lot and on the item's edit screen. Stock buttons: All stock, Available stock, Expired. A new item on a bill appears at the top. Fixed: a bill marked Full no longer leaves a small due after round-off, and the pop-up for a payment or a return now uses the right words.
